articles.title: The gaming creator with more than 26 million followers just launched his own holding company
articles.summary: Cody "Clix" Conrod is a professional Fortnite player with over 26 million followers and nine creator-focused businesses. Now he has his own holdco.

articles.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
articles.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
